classification: Present since the per-period properties were introduced.
evidence: The original mapper initializes six keys to `NSNull` and then removes them by assigning nil optionals. Executing that unmodified historical mapper reproduces all six missing fields; six non-null controls remain present. The same PR already documented “Null for INAPP products.” [#1195](https://github.com/RevenueCat/purchases-hybrid-common/pull/1195) later corrected TypeScript nullability (2025-07-09); it did not introduce the serialization defect. The parent had no per-period fields.
limitations: Unmodified historical mapper compiled on macOS with synthetic RevenueCat product properties. A separate type alias resolves the current StoreKit name collision. No full 2024 SDK/app build was executed.
